narrative.northStar: Build the page with cursor arrows
narrative.overview: Cursor arrows assemble the interface from the header through the contact section. They draw guides through text, place links with a click, and pull open the terminal and project images.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal and warm white, with a blue signal.
A working terminal alongside the display name.
Repeated cursor assembly with native scrolling and a static fallback.
